preconditions.description: Input constraints: number of data centers (n) is at least 2, number of clients (m) is at least 1, and day length (h) is at least 2.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= uj < h for uj in u)
preconditions.description: Each data center's maintenance hour (uj) is a non-negative integer less than the day length (h).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci1 <= n and 1 <= ci2 <= n and ci1 != ci2 for (ci1, ci2) in clients)
preconditions.description: Each client's data centers (ci1, ci2) are distinct and within the valid range of data center indices (1 to n).

preconditions.expression: all(u[ci1 - 1] != u[ci2 - 1] for (ci1, ci2) in clients)
preconditions.description: Initially, no two data centers storing the same client's data have the same maintenance hour.

postconditions.description: The number of data centers (k) to shift is at least 1 and at most n.

postconditions.expression: len(selected) == k and all(1 <= x <= n for x in selected) and len(set(selected)) == k
postconditions.description: The selected data centers (selected) are distinct, within the valid range, and exactly k in number.

postconditions.expression: all(u[(x - 1) % n] != u[(y - 1) % n] for (x, y) in clients for u in [u, [((uj + 1) % h) if j + 1 in selected else uj for j, uj in enumerate(u)]])
postconditions.description: After shifting the maintenance hours of the selected data centers by one hour, no two data centers storing the same client's data have the same maintenance hour.
